AWS.label: yes
AWS.note: AWS Backup Vault Lock (governance/compliance mode) prevents deletion or lifecycle changes of backups in a locked vault.

Acronis.label: yes
Acronis.note: Immutable storage prevents deletion or modification of restore points until retention expires.

Afi.ai.label: yes
Afi.ai.note: Immutable backup datastore format plus optional underlying object-storage retention locking.

Arcserve.label: yes
Arcserve.note: Immutable snapshots on Arcserve Cyber Resilient / Cloud Cyber Resilient data stores.

Arctera.label: yes
Arctera.note: Backup Exec supports cloud immutable (WORM) storage via S3 Object Lock and Azure immutable blob storage.

Atempo.label: yes
Atempo.note: Miria immutable disk repository (XFS immutability flags); Tina offers WORM immutability options.

AvePoint.label: yes
AvePoint.note: FAQ states AvePoint Cloud Backup backup data is immutable (immutable storage, no direct access).

Axcient.label: yes
Axcient.note: x360Recover documents immutable backups that cannot be altered after completion.

Bacula.label: yes
Bacula.note: SetVolumeImmutable sets disk volume immutable attribute; cloud parts can be WORM/immutable.

Barracuda.label: yes
Barracuda.note: Maintains immutable backup copies by preventing direct access and API modification/removal.

CloudCasa.label: yes
CloudCasa.note: Supports immutability on user object stores via S3 Object Lock / Azure immutable storage.

Cohesity.label: yes
Cohesity.note: NetBackup supports cloud immutable (WORM) storage with S3 Object Lock and MSDP cloud immutable storage.

Commvault.label: yes
Commvault.note: Immutable snapshots on supported storage arrays (INFINIDAT, Hitachi, HPE, NetApp).

Datto.label: yes
Datto.note: Backup data written to Datto immutable cloud storage; ZFS snapshots are immutable.

Dell.label: yes
Dell.note: Avamar limited (immutable) backup management and Data Domain Retention Lock.

Druva.label: yes
Druva.note: Data Lock prevents modification/deletion and makes backup data immutable.

Eon.label: yes
Eon.note: Backup policies can apply AWS Backup vault lock in governance/compliance mode, making backups immutable until retention expiry.

Google.label: yes
Google.note: Backup vaults provide immutable and indelible storage for backups.

HYCU.label: yes
HYCU.note: Backing up to targets with WORM / immutability policy enabled is supported, retention honours WORM.

Hornetsecurity (Altaro).label: yes
Hornetsecurity (Altaro).note: VM Backup supports immutable offsite backup locations with versioning and object locking.

IBM.label: yes
IBM.note: WORM-protected file volumes via NetApp SnapLock or IBM Storage Scale immutable filesets.

Keepit.label: yes
Keepit.note: Keepit states immutable, air-gapped backup storage.

Microsoft.label: yes
Microsoft.note: Immutable vaults (optionally irreversible) and time-based immutability for Recovery Services vaults.

N-Able.label: yes
N-Able.note: Cove Fortified Copies create immutable backups by default.

Nakivo.label: yes
Nakivo.note: Recovery points can be made immutable (WORM) in S3/Wasabi/Azure/B2 repositories using object lock.

NinjaOne (Dropsuite).label: yes
NinjaOne (Dropsuite).note: WORM storage option in NinjaOne SaaS Backup (FINRA WORM).

Portworx.label: yes
Portworx.note: Immutable backup locations via S3 object lock and Azure Blob immutable containers.

Red Hat.label: yes
Red Hat.note: OADP 1.4+ supports backup data immutability using AWS S3 buckets with versioning/object lock (with limitations).

Rubrik.label: yes
Rubrik.note: Object-level immutability for S3-compatible archives and RCV; blob-level immutability on Azure.

Salesforce.label: unclear
Salesforce.note: Only Blockchain Verify tamper-evidence for backups and read-only archive; no explicit immutable backup storage.

Slide.label: yes
Slide.note: FAQ: backups are stored as ZFS snapshots, so they are immutable.

Storware.label: yes
Storware.note: Immutable Backup Destination on XFS-based storage and S3 object lock support.

Synology.label: yes
Synology.note: Data immutability with Synology WORM on appliance and Object Lock on remote storage.

Trilio.label: yes
Trilio.note: Supports immutable backups on object-lock-enabled targets.

Veeam.label: yes
Veeam.note: Immutability for backup files prohibits deletion from repositories for a period.

Zerto.label: yes
Zerto.note: Retention sets can be made immutable on S3/Azure/S3-compatible repositories via versioning and object lock.
